name: What is different about renovating an older coastal home in Coronado or Imperial Beach?

mainEntity.name: What is different about renovating an older coastal home in Coronado or Imperial Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: In coastal communities such as Coronado and Imperial Beach, moisture, salt air, wind exposure, drainage, and exterior-material durability deserve early attention. Context: those conditions can affect doors, windows, fasteners, finishes, stucco, and water-management details, while the exact requirements depend on the property and jurisdiction. Key factors: distance from the ocean, existing corrosion, roof and flashing condition, drainage, exterior alterations, and any coastal review. Practical guidance: ask the design team to inspect vulnerable exterior transitions and specify materials suited to exposure. Confirm whether proposed exterior work needs local review before ordering. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate property conditions into a coordinated design and construction plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pay extra attention to salt-air corrosion, moisture, drainage, flashing, stucco, windows, doors, and durable exterior materials. Before changing the exterior, verify the property’s local review requirements and include water-management details in the design.
